statement: Written and committed before the final nested evaluation was run. After this commit no model, grid, selection rule, comparator setting or reported comparison is changed. Results are a post-freeze evaluation on a reused public benchmark (LIMORE and LCCL scores were already seen in Track A, commit b442fd8), not a blind cohort.

design_history.initial_design: soft prior (eta) + nuclear-norm multi-drug shrinkage (tau), one configuration for all drugs (R1-2)
design_history.modification_1: shared low-rank fit + per-drug Ridge on its training residuals, lambda2 per drug (R1-3); adopted by the pre-written rule
design_history.budget: initial design + at most two diagnosis-backed modifications

models_and_selection: configs/softprior_multitask_r1/analysis.yaml: sections models, grids, final, objective.tie_break, objective.selection_loss

evaluation.internal: family 5-fold x 3 repeats (Track A split table, reused), inner family 3-fold inside every outer-training set; every configuration is refitted per outer-training set and each model picks from that set's inner losses only
evaluation.external: LCCL, 18 matched single agents; LIMORE-only training; shared families: that family removed from LIMORE training; new lineages (4 families) reported separately; Spearman(prediction, -AUC) primary, -GI50 secondary; AA and AUC never pooled
evaluation.primary_metric: family-balanced macro-drug normalised RMSE (Track A definition, denominator = AA SD of the outer-training fold)
evaluation.wins_means: the 95% family-bootstrap interval of the paired difference lies entirely below zero
evaluation.permuted_prior: 20 whole-axis gene-label permutations (seeds 101-120) through the identical nested path

comparators.A0_A1_A1r_A3: Track A routines and alpha grid on the fixed-ID axis; internal predictions from run r0_tracka_cdbf857 (R1-0, deterministic), external from run_track_a_external.py
comparators.enet: raw log2-FPKM ElasticNet per drug, 7 alpha x 3 l1_ratio, same inner folds and loss (configs: baselines.enet)
comparators.cwkbmf: authors' MATLAB archive (sha256 98759b68ea0e5bd9224b80b1b2bd4d4c778280fd394440bb8d2c48d469a8f236) run unmodified under GNU Octave 6.4.0; 50 Hallmark kernels + 1 kernel of the remaining genes, Gaussian kernel exp(-d^2/n_genes) on standardised rank RNA, identity drug kernel, published hyper-parameters (1,1,1,1; 0.1,0.1,1), 200 iterations, seed 1606, R in {10,20} by inner CV; unweighted fit. Kernel construction, iteration count and R set are this study's choices because the archive has no data pipeline
comparators.tabpfn: TabPFN package 10.0.0, v2 regressor weights (newer default weights require an account registration, not done), CPU, random_state 0, default settings, per drug, training-only PCA to min(50, n_train - 1) dimensions of standardised rank RNA; nothing tuned
comparators.not_run: GCNPath and other large external methods: the plan allows them only after a sufficient contribution is seen

planned_runs.note: run ids carry the frozen code commit; the freeze manifest itself is added by the next commit, which changes no code or config

development_evidence_before_freeze.source: inner folds of the 15 outer-training sets only (reports/softprior_multitask_r1/tables/r2_*, r3_*, r4_*)
development_evidence_before_freeze.note: outer-test labels of the 15 folds and all LCCL labels were not read by any R1 development step; they had been read by Track A
